tcp.control_plane: REST (microvm-rest) and gRPC (microvm-grpc) servers bind ONLY tokio::net::UnixListener with socket mode 0660 and peer-credential auth; no TCP listener exists in the control plane.
tcp.legitimate_tcp: microvm-firecracker TcpHealthProbe is an OUTBOUND guest-readiness probe (connects to the guest VM IP for the warm HTTP-function demo); it is not a control-plane listener. transport-contract FORBIDDEN_TCP_PATTERNS/scan_for_tcp_patterns is the F4 scope guard plus its own test fixtures (0.0.0.0/127.0.0.1 literals are detector fixtures, not config).
tcp.config_scan: grep for 0.0.0.0/tcp:///[::]/localhost: across api/, schemas/, docs/, manifests returned zero matches outside the detector crate's tests.

remote_pull.detail: OCI importer is local-only: remote/tag-only references (https://, docker://, registry:) are rejected with ImportError::RemoteReference before any I/O; the crate performs no network I/O. All 'registry' references in code are rejection paths ('digest-pinned registry references are not permitted').

rootless_vfio_live_migration.detail: grep for rootless/vfio/live-migration/passthrough/gpu across crates/ returned zero non-comment/non-test matches; none of these behaviors are implemented.

general_oci.detail: microvm-oci is a constrained local import surface, not an OCI runtime: it rejects host mounts, capabilities (cap_add/cap_drop), privileged mode, host namespaces, and arbitrary host process controls via ForbiddenField; help text and tests assert it disclaims 'OCI runtime compatible'.

forbidden_files.detail: git status --porcelain -- .codegraph .omo/run-continuation is empty; neither .codegraph/ (symlink to framework codegraph) nor .omo/run-continuation/ has any changed file. The only working-tree change produced by this run is .omo/evidence/kvm-microvm-orchestrator/summary.json (the reducer output).

release_gate_policy.statement: Benchmark targets (e.g. the <200ms snapshot/restore figure) are measured distributions published with host metadata, never boolean release gates. Blocked privileged/benchmark evidence is preserved verbatim with explicit host reasons and is never erased or promoted to pass. The reducer is fail-closed: deterministic lane has no blocked state, privileged pass requires real-substrate proof (anti-mock), and benchmark never records pass (anti-boolean). semantic_violations=0.
